evidence.quote: The relevant dimensions are included in the PDF.
There is a set of measured drawings in PDF form in the Extras section.

R1.reason: Dimensions of the Leg and False Drawer Front cutout templates exist only in the Extras PDF; viewed images 8ba04be74dab35b5 (drawing page unreadable) and 49cd346ee3fe0365 show the shapes without dimensions. All outer part sizes, assembly offsets and drawer formulas are in the text/cut list, so the build can be completed with a builder-drawn cutout (decorative shape): Fix level. Later 'Extras' mentions (roundover bit, Duplo plates links) are optional credits.

R2.reason: Rejected flagged candidate: '1/16" to 1/8"' in steps[29] is the reveal trimmed off the False Fronts, not a part. Steps' Leg = cutList[1] 'End'; Center Divider = cutList[4] 'Center Support'; all other parts match by name; templates are cut from materials[3] 1/4" MDF.

R3.reason: Rejected flagged candidate: 'Center Support' (cutList[4], 0.75 x 6.5 x 30.25) is the 'Center Divider' of steps[9],[13] (no other cut row is unmatched and no other step part is unmatched); naming mismatch noted in gaps. All 9 rows are used.

R4.basis: Kreg-corrected cut rows vs board materials (§9)

R5.reason: R5 precondition not met: 3 stock types (sheet-0.75, sheet-0.5, sheet-0.25); steps not checked for per-part stock

R6.reason: Rejected flagged candidate: steps[11] '1-1/4” coarse thread Kreg Screws' is materials[4] '1-1/4 Pocket Screws - Box'. 3/4" Micro screws (materials[6]) for 1/2" drawer parts, #8 x 1" washer head (materials[10], step 28 '#8 x 1” washer head screws'), #6 x 1" for drawer bottoms (materials[11]); no conflicting sizes.

R8.reason: Parts cut, templates and cutouts, pocket holes drilled, base assembled (top trim, legs, divider, braces), drawers built, slides installed, false fronts attached last. Geometry is consistent: top 30.25 + 2 x 0.75 trim = 31.75 = End length.

evidence.quote: I absolutely prefer the Kreg Micro when working with 1/2” plywood.

R9.reason: Recorded only (R9 does not count). Base pocket holes are in 3/4" plywood (steps[7]-[10]) and drawer pocket holes in 1/2" plywood (steps[21]); no jig thickness setting is stated for either (search of steps[7]-[12],[21],[22] for setting/thickness/collar: none); viewed images d3082fe4f65234cd and 49cd346ee3fe0365 show drilled holes only.

R10.reason: Leg Brace offset 1-1/2" and spacers 5-7/8" (steps[14]); divider centered between legs with reference line (steps[13]); slide height marked with a 3" spacer resting on the leg brace (viewed image 6624fa92b2736fd9) and front offset = 3/4" false-front thickness (steps[24]); slides centered on drawer side; groove 1/4" blade height and fence (steps[18]); 4 false-front holes per drawer, any placement through the 1/2" front works (viewed 69275e835f84193a); reveals 1/16-1/8" (steps[29]). Sweep candidates are relational or image-shown.

R11.note: 3 reference(s), each in a step with its own image

evidence.quote: There is also a link to the Duplo build plates in Extras.

R14.reason: (d) Materials list 4 Duplo Build Plates (qty 4) but no step attaches, positions or sizes them (search of steps for /plate/: only steps[32], a purchase-link mention), so the steps end without the play surface the table is made for. Fix level: the plywood table is complete and usable without them. Counts otherwise agree: 8 washer-head screws = 4 holes x 2 drawers; 2 slide pairs = 4 slides (steps[25]-[26]).

gaps.what: Cut list names differ from the steps for the same parts: 'Center Support' vs steps[9]/[13] 'Center Divider', and cutList[1] 'End' vs steps 'Leg'; a builder matching rows to steps must infer the pairing.
